svg.title: CoFounder Full Multi-Agent Architecture
svg.desc: Detailed architecture diagram showing how all CoFounder agents, tools, APIs, LLMs, the 11-node knowledge graph, MongoDB Atlas, and the frontend connect into one system.
svg.text: How every agent, tool, API route, LLM, graph node, and store connects into one living startup OS
idea -> orchestrator -> planner -> researchers -> MongoDB graph | SSE live feed | voice/chat | surgical pivot | export

g.text: Single human in the loop - drops an idea, talks to the orb, approves pivots, exports when ready
Entry: create workspace > graph born > agents start filling gaps
Exit: export scaffold zip when revenue + product + tech ready
L2 | Frontend (Vite | React | TypeScript | React Flow | Zustand)
cofounder-alpha.vercel.app | renders the living graph, voice orb, panels, and SSE chaos
React Flow | confidence rings | unlock logic | agent chips
Idea Framer | Audience Scout | Market Analyst | Competitor Tracker
Revenue Modeler | Product Strategist | Tech Architect | Build Engineer
Launch Coordinator | Signal Observer | Growth Agent | Research Agent
Each graph node type has a named specialist persona + agent_id
main.py bootstraps one GraphStore (Atlas or in-memory) | CORS | route groups under /api
create graph from idea | load full graph
L4 | Orchestration Brain - the single co-founder that coordinates everything
Two faces of the same brain: session spawner (graph > plan > research) and conversational tool-caller (voice/chat > tools)
4. Clarify core idea via Gemini Pro
6. Stream every step to SSE feed
Triggers: manual | workspace create | pivot | node approve | custom spawn
" Confirms actions for live feed visibility
Persona: 'single AI co-founder coordinating specialist sub-agents'
execute_tool() routes into spawn / growth / diff classifier / export / UI actions
L5 | Specialist Agent Roster - every named brain in the system
Orchestrator spawns / calls these; each owns a slice of the startup graph or a cross-cutting concern
Node-Bound Specialist Personas (agent chips on the canvas)
Mapped in NODE_AGENT_IDS / NODE_AGENT_CONFIG - researchers write into these node identities
L6 | Research Loop Detail - Planner -> Task Queue -> Researcher -> Critique -> Graph Write
Karpathy-style self-critique: attempt > tool scan > synthesize > score > retry until good enough or max_attempts
spawn_research_agents - creates custom_research nodes + parallel sub-agents
User: 'research X, Y, and current solutions'
> Research Agents run in parallel sessions
> evidence lands on new nodes + SSE stream
Researchers and specialist agents call these - no headless browser process required for market evidence
web scrape | page evidence | market pages
Model split by job weight - Pro for judgment, Flash for volume
All API + agent ops share one async GraphStore | Atlas preferred, Memory fallback
MONGODB_URI required in prod | scripts/init_atlas_indexes.py | seed_knowledge_base.py
L9 | Living Knowledge Graph - 11 Canonical Nodes + Unlock Tech Tree
graph/schema.py | unlock_engine.py - confidence e threshold unlocks children | custom_research nodes attach on demand
needs Revenue + Tech | Build Observer / GitHub
active_agents[] chips show who is working the node
End-to-End Connection Map - how it all becomes one system
User > Frontend > POST /workspace > graph born in Atlas
Master / Conversational Orchestrator reads graph, picks tools
Planner queues tasks > Researchers pull tools > Critique scores
Nodes update | unlock engine opens next layer | SSE paints UI
Dialogue Q | Growth priority | Diff Classifier on pivot
Export Agent zips scaffold when revenue+product+tech ready
Side loops that reconnect into the same spine:
Voice Orb " Deepgram " Conversational Orchestrator " tools " same research/export paths
Build Observer " GitHub " Build node | Observe Agent " PostHog " Observe node | Growth Agent " Today's Priority UI
Pivot > Diff Classifier > surgical re-queue > Researchers > only affected nodes reset | everything still streams via SSE
